tag.description: The unique identifier for the setting.

value.description: The current value of the setting at `LOCATION` level. If the tag value is not set at the `LOCATION` level, this field will not be included in the response.

parentValue.description: The value inherited from the immediate parent level above `LOCATION`. It can be `SYSTEM_DEFAULT`, `REGIONAL_DEFAULT`, `ORGANIZATION`, or `LOCATION`, depending on which level the setting is actually configured at. If there is no parent level for this tag, this field will not be included in the response.
